schema:
CREATE TABLE businesses (
  address,
  application_date,
  business_certificate,
  business_id,
  city,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  name,
  owner_address,
  owner_city,
  owner_name,
  owner_state,
  owner_zip,
  phone_number,
  postal_code,
  tax_code
);

CREATE TABLE violations (
  business_id,
  date,
  description,
  risk_category,
  violation_type_id
);
